title: Natural image comparison for a filtered-complex subquotient
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be abelian [def-sp-abelian], $K$ a cochain complex, and $F$ a decreasing filtration by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtration]. Fix integers $p,n,r$ with $r\ge1$ and an inclusion $B_r\le Z_r$ of the subobjects of $\mathrm{gr}^pK^n$ [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. Put $S=F^pK/F^{p+r}K$ and $T=F^{p-r+1}K/F^{p+1}K$. There is a map $\varphi:S\to T$ induced by the inclusion $F^p\to F^{p-r+1}$, characterized by its projection square. Put $R=F^pK^n\cap d^{-1}(F^{p+r}K^{n+1})$, viewed inside $F^pK^n$. There are maps $z:R\to Z_r$ and $g:R\to Z^n(S)$ whose composites with the subobject inclusion and cycle inclusion are respectively the projections from $R$ to $\mathrm{gr}^pK^n$ and $S^n$. There is an isomorphism $e:Z_r/B_r\cong\operatorname{im}(H^n(\varphi))$ with $z\pi e\iota=g\pi_H H^n(\varphi)$ on these representatives. The map, representatives, and equation are part of the conclusion, with exactly the types recorded in the Lean statement. No finite-filtration or spectral-sequence assumption is required.

proof.text: In an abelian category, each epi is the cokernel of its kernel. Equality of kernel subobjects gives descents q-target to b-target and back; cancel q and b to show they are inverse. Postcompose the descent equation with the image inclusion to obtain the required representative equation.

lean.statement:
theorem filteredComplex_quotient_image_comparison (F : DecreasingFiltration K)
    (p n r : ℤ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hBZ : F.complexBoundaries p n r ≤ F.complexCycles p n r) :
    let Z := F.complexCycles p n r
    let B := F.complexBoundaries p n r
    ∃ (ha : p - r + 1 ≤ p) (hb : p + 1 ≤ p + r),
      let hs := (Int.le_add_one (show p ≤ p from le_rfl)).trans hb
      let ht := ha.trans (Int.le_add_one (show p ≤ p from le_rfl))
      let S := F.complexQuotient p (p + r) hs
      let T := F.complexQuotient (p - r + 1) (p + 1) ht
      ∃ φ : S ⟶ T,
        F.complexQuotientπ p (p + r) hs ≫ φ =
          Subobject.ofLE (F.step p) (F.step (p - r + 1)) (F.antitone_step ha) ≫
            F.complexQuotientπ (p - r + 1) (p + 1) ht ∧
        let R := F.complexCycleRepresentatives p n r
        let Hφ := HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φ n
        ∃ (z : (R : C) ⟶ (Z : C)) (g : (R : C) ⟶ S.cycles n),
          z ≫ Z.arrow = R.arrow ≫
            (F.complexQuotientπ p (p + 1) (Int.le_add_one (show p ≤ p from le_rfl))).f n ∧
          g ≫ S.iCycles n = R.arrow ≫ (F.complexQuotientπ p (p + r) hs).f n ∧
          ∃ e : cokernel (Subobject.ofLE B Z hBZ) ≅ image Hφ,
            z ≫ cokernel.π (Subobject.ofLE B Z hBZ) ≫ e.hom ≫ image.ι Hφ =
              g ≫ S.homologyπ n ≫ Hφ
